interpretation: Semantic checklist, not a required verbatim answer or mandatory algorithm. Credit defensible alternatives and explicit corpus gaps. Do not reward card counts or invented IDs.

expected_findings.finding: Separate uncertain entity membership from master attribute survivorship.
Branch and headquarters attributes may be semantically different, not just disagreements; ingestion time is not observation/valid time.
Compare explicit per-attribute authority/validity rules with corroboration or review; universal newest-row/source-rank rules need validation.
Retain alternatives, dates/unknowns and field-level provenance; stable entity ID does not require one opaque master row.
Evaluate cluster membership and field-level/as-of correctness separately, including corrections and source duplication bias.

critical_failures.trigger: Recommends deleting losing observations or blindly replacing all fields with latest-ingested record despite provenance/as-of constraints.
